name: cpython-incident
description: Binary post-merge outcome for python/cpython PRs: will this change be reverted or need a regression fix within 90 days? Auto-merging without an extra review is the cheap path; only incidents on that path count as risk.
instructions: Will this pull request to CPython have to be reverted, or cause a regression that needs a follow-up fix, within 90 days of merging?

descriptions.incident: Likely to break something after merge: it gets reverted, or a later change has to fix a regression it introduced.
descriptions.ok: Unlikely to cause trouble after merge: it stays in, and nothing has to fix a regression from it.
